name: Emma Ytterell - Article 10, § 4 - Am 125
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 4. From [OP: please insert the date = twenty-four months after the date of entry into force of this Regulation], Member States shall also take the necessary measures to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of their environmental assessment and screening procedures, including through the use of automated systems. The choice, development and deployment of such systems shall remain within the competence of Member States. These automated systems shall be aligned with relevant Union policies, respect data protection and privacy laws, and adhere to principles of transparency and accountability, including human decisional control. Final decisions on environmental assessments shall remain the responsibility of the competent national authorities.
